The function DeFrogs.startApplyingLimit() is controlled by the onlyOwner modifier, meaning only the owner can invoke it.
This function modifies the applyTxLimit variable, which is used as a conditional check in the DeFrogs._transfer() function.
If applyTxLimit is set to true, it can prevent transfers from occurring, effectively limiting the ability of regular users to trade.
Since the owner can toggle this limit at will, it directly impacts the trading capabilities of all users, classifying it as a LIMIT behavior.
The function DeFrogs.stopApplyingLimit() is controlled by onlyOwner, which means only the owner can call this function to modify the applyTxLimit variable.
The applyTxLimit variable directly affects the conditional check in the DeFrogs._transfer() function, determining whether transfers can proceed or not.
If the owner sets applyTxLimit to true, it can effectively block all transfers for regular users, thus limiting their ability to trade.
This control over the transaction limit by the owner classifies this path as a LIMIT behavior.
